nodes.label: Semantic Colour Tokens
nodes.rationale: Only token files contain raw colour values; components consume semantic names (paper/rule/ink/accent/success/warning/danger), every semantic colour is paired with text and an icon, and the accent stays under roughly 3% of a viewport.

nodes.label: Status Grammar
nodes.rationale: Five status families (success, attention, blocking, active/transport, neutral) each pair label, symbol family, and colour; status copy names the observed condition before offering a remedy, and 'Something went wrong' is banned.

nodes.label: Truth Rule
nodes.rationale: Never invent cost savings, success rates, urgency, health, or completion; unknown, stale, skipped, pre-existing, and inconclusive are real states with their own language, and the product reports state rather than performing urgency through decoration.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass Boundary
nodes.rationale: On iOS 26 native Liquid Glass is limited to tab/navigation and transient controls while evidence, timelines, and approval content stay on standard surfaces; glass remains prohibited in the Expo prototype and glassmorphism is prohibited entirely on web.

nodes.label: Accessibility Release Contract (WCAG 2.2 AA)
nodes.rationale: Web targets WCAG 2.2 AA with 4.5:1 body contrast; iOS supports VoiceOver, Voice Control, Differentiate Without Color, Increase Contrast, Reduce Motion, Bold Text, and the largest accessibility Dynamic Type size; keyboard/VoiceOver order follows visual and risk order with raw logs never preceding current state, proof, or action.
